reason: This clause inserts the Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Domestic and International Business into the membership list in section 305 of Executive Order No. 10973, which establishes the Development Loan Committee. It ends when the parent order's section 305 ends. Executive Order 12163 (signed September 29, 1979; 44 FR 56673) revokes "Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3,1961, as amended;" in section 1-903(a)(1), and section 1-905 makes the order effective "as of" October 1, 1979 (the text prints "October 1,1979."). Section 1-505 of the same order re-establishes a Development Loan Committee "in accordance with section 122(e)" and gives it a new member list that names "the Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Industry" and Trade, not the office inserted by this order. The strike-and-insert ruling of 2026-10-21 makes the insertion continue until the parent ends, and the replacement list shows why the revocation extinguished this command rather than being a bare cleanup. First end 1979-10-01, read inclusively (the clause was last in force on September 30, 1979). No earlier end is shown (see the order-level checks).
